{{Quote|Our village has been attack by Tusken Raiders! It was horrible, so many of my friends fell so swiftly, so few of us got away...|Tolan Nokkar, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TN" />}}
'''Tolan Nokkar''' was a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TN" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|He's dead? We are forever in your debt. The survivors of our village has gathered what we could to show our appreciation for your heroism. It's not much, but all we have, please accept it.|Tolan Nokkar, to a spacer after the death of the Tusken King|<ref name="SWG:TN" />}}
Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Tolan Nokkar lived in a [[Tusken Village|village]]<ref name="SWG:TN" /> of [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]],<ref name="SWG:AC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|A commoner|Tatooine}}</ref> located in the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]] of the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:TN" />

[[File:TolanNokkarsRefugeeCamp-SWG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The refugee camp used by Tolan Nokkar and other escaped villagers]]

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the village was attacked and taken over by a tribe of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] led by a [[Tusken King (rank)|Tusken King]]. Most of the villagers were killed but Tolan Nokkar and a few of the villagers managed to escape. They established a refugee camp in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], not far from the village.<ref name="SWG:TN" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Tolan Nokkar encountered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] in the camp. Nokkar begged the spacer to kill the Tusken King. The spacer headed to the pillaged village and fought the Tusken King and other Tuskens who would get in the way. The spacer succeeded and returned to Nokkar. Tolan Nokkar was thankful and gave the spacer 20,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] pooled together by the surviving villagers as a reward. Tolan Nokkar and other survivors thus planed to move back into the village as soon as they drove the remaining Tusken Raiders away.<ref name="SWG:TN" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Tolan Nokkar]]
Tolan Nokkar was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:TN" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Due to the nature of some characters in ''Galaxies'', Tolan Nokkar's appearance was randomized during each server reset. Therefore, the [[canon]]ical [[Species/Legends|species]] and [[Gender/Legends|gender]] of Nokkar remains unidentified. Species Nokkar could appear as included, but were not necessarily limited to, [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]], and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]].<ref name="SWG:TN" />
